data.title: 妮姆芙 · 被摸头时傲娇拍开又偷偷蹭过来的反差
data.description: 落樱纷飞的河堤草坪上，当你伸手摸她的脑袋时，妮姆芙先是鼓起腮帮娇嗔着拍开你的手，下一秒却眼睫轻颤，把小脑袋主动蹭进你的掌心里，透明双翼轻轻扇动，展现无敌的反差萌。
data.location: grassy riverbank under shade of cherry blossom trees
data.action: standing in front of partner, initially batting his hand away with a pouting blush before shyly leaning her forehead back into his palm with fluttering wings
data.lighting: dappled sunlight filtering through spring blossom canopy
data.mood: pinnacle tsundere gap moe, adorable surrender, trembling emotional warmth
data.promptProse: Under blooming cherry blossoms on a riverbank, Nymph pouts and bats away a hand before shyly nuzzling her forehead into partner palm with fluttering wings.
data.animaCaption: Nymph shyly nuzzling her head into partner palm under blossoms.
